translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from dissension, hypocrisy, and bad manners.

title: Comprehensive Dua for All Good and Refuge from All Evil (taught to Aisha)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'oodhu bika minash-sharri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam. Allahumma innee as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allahumma innee as'alukal-jannata wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa a'oodhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa as'aluka an taj'ala kulla qada'in qadaytahu lee khayra.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for all good, both immediate and future, that which I know of and that which I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all evil, both immediate and future, that which I know of and that which I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that Your servant and Prophet sought refuge from. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever words or deeds bring one closer to it, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever words or deeds bring one closer to it. And I ask You to make every decree that You decree for me good.

title: Dua for Relief from Overwhelming Debt and Worry
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ فَالِقَ الْإِصْبَاحِ، وَجَاعِلَ اللَّيْلِ سَكَنًا، وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا، اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ، وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَمَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَقُوَّتِي فِي سَبِيلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma Faliqal-isbahi, wa Ja'ilal-layli sakanan, wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbanan, iqdi 'annid-dayna, wa aghninee minal-faqri, wa matti'nee bi-sam'ee wa basaree wa quwwatee fee sabeelik.
translation: O Allah, Cleaver of daybreak, Maker of the night for rest, and the sun and moon for calculation: settle my debt for me, enrich me from poverty, and let me enjoy my hearing, my sight, and my strength in Your cause.

title: Dua for Protection from Being Overpowered by Debt or Enemies
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الْعَدُوِّ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni, wa ghalabatil-'aduwwi, wa shamatatil-a'da'.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt, from being overpowered by the enemy, and from the gloating of enemies.

title: Prophetic Ruqyah for Healing the Sick
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nasi, adhhibil-ba'sa, ishfi Antash-Shafee, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.
translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction; cure [him/her], for You are the Healer. There is no cure except Your cure—a cure that leaves no illness behind.

title: Ruqyah of Jibril for the Prophet
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
transliteration: Bismillahi arqeeka, min kulli shay'in yu'dheeka, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni hasidin, Allahu yashfeeka, bismillahi arqeek.
translation: In the name of Allah I perform Ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye; may Allah cure you. In the name of Allah I perform Ruqyah for you.

title: Refuge from Leprosy, Madness, and Evil Diseases
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-barasi, wal-junooni, wal-judhami, wa min sayyi'il-asqam.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leukoderma, madness, leprosy, and from evil diseases.

title: Ruqyah Using Dust and Saliva for Sores or Wounds
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا، بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا، يُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا، بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا
transliteration: Bismillahi, turbatu ardina, bi-reeqati ba'dina, yushfa saqeemuna, bi-idhni Rabbina.
translation: In the name of Allah, the dust of our earth mixed with the saliva of some of us, curing our sick by the permission of our Lord.

title: Dua for Health in Body, Hearing, and Sight
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي، وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي، وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ يَظْلِمُنِي، وَخُذْ مِنْهُ بِثَأْرِي
transliteration: Allahumma matti'nee bi-sam'ee wa basaree, waj'alhumal-waritha minnee, wansurnee 'ala man yadhlimunee, wa khudh minhu bi-tha'ree.
translation: O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and my sight, and make them remain with me until I die; grant me victory over he who wrongs me, and take my revenge upon him.

title: Ruqyah for Fever and Pain
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْكَبِيرِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ نَعَّارٍ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَرِّ النَّارِ
transliteration: Bismillahil-Kabeer, a'oodhu billahil-'Adheemi min sharri kulli 'irqin na''arin, wa min sharri harrin-nar.
translation: In the name of Allah, the Great; I seek refuge in Allah, the Magnificent, from the evil of every throbbing vein and from the evil of the heat of the Fire.

title: Dua When Visiting a Sick Person Asking About Their Condition
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ عَبْدَكَ يَنْكَأُ لَكَ عَدُوًّا، أَوْ يَمْشِي لَكَ إِلَى صَلَاةٍ
transliteration: Allahummash-fi 'abdaka yanka'u laka 'aduwwan, aw yamshee laka ila salah.
translation: O Allah, cure Your servant so that he may inflict harm on an enemy for Your sake, or walk to prayer for Your sake.

title: Ruqyah of Jibril Against All Harm
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ يُبْرِيكَ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ يَشْفِيكَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ، وَشَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Bismillahi yubreeka, wa min kulli da'in yashfeeka, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasada, wa sharri kulli dhee 'ayn.
translation: In the name of Allah, may He cure you, and from every illness may He heal you, and from the evil of an envier when he envies, and from the evil of everyone with the evil eye.

title: Quranic Verse of Healing for the Believers
arabicText: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'mineen.
translation: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers.

title: Ibrahim's Praise of Allah Who Heals When Sick
arabicText: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
transliteration: Wa idha maridtu fahuwa yashfeen.
translation: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

title: Dua for Blessing a Gathering
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ، وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ، وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا، وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا، وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا، وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا، وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا
transliteration: Allahummaq-sim lana min khashyatika ma yahoolu baynana wa bayna ma'aseeka, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannataka, wa minal-yaqeeni ma tuhawwinu bihi 'alayna museebatid-dunya. Wa matti'na bi-asma'ina wa absarina wa quwwatina ma ahyaytana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tha'rana 'ala man dhalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al museebatana fee deenina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina, wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alayna man la yarhamuna.
translation: O Allah, apportion to us such fear of You as will come between us and Your disobedience; and of Your obedience such as will bring us to Your Paradise; and of certainty such as will make easy for us the calamities of this world. Let us enjoy our hearing, our sight, and our strength as long as You keep us alive, and make them remain with us until we die. Make our vengeance restricted to those who have wronged us, support us against those who show enmity to us, do not make our affliction be in our religion, do not make this world our greatest concern nor the limit of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who will not have mercy on us.

title: Dua for Mutual Love Among Believers
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا، وَقُلُوبِنَا، وَأَزْوَاجِنَا، وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا عَلَيْكَ، قَابِلِيهَا، وَأَتِمِمْهَا عَلَيْنَا
transliteration: Allahumma allif bayna quloobina, wa aslih dhata baynina, wahdina subulas-salami, wa najjina minadh-dhulumati ilan-noori, wa jannibnal-fawahisha ma dhahara minha wa ma batana, wa barik lana fee asma'ina, wa absarina, wa quloobina, wa azwajina, wa dhurriyyatina, wa tub 'alayna innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Raheem, waj'alna shakireena li-ni'amika muthneena biha 'alayka, qabileeha, wa atimimha 'alayna.
translation: O Allah, unite our hearts, mend our social relations, guide us to the paths of peace, bring us out from darkness into light, keep us away from indecencies whether apparent or hidden, and bless us in our hearing, our sight, our hearts, our spouses, and our offspring. Accept our repentance; indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Your blessings, praising You for them, accepting them, and complete them upon us.

title: Dua for Blessing in Understanding the Religion (Taught for Ibn Abbas)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ وَعَلِّمْهُ التَّأْوِيلَ
transliteration: Allahumma faqqih-hu fid-deeni wa 'allimhut-ta'weel.
translation: O Allah, grant him deep understanding of the religion and teach him the interpretation [of the Qur'an].

title: Dua for Increase in Wealth and Children and Blessing Therein (Taught for Anas)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma akthir malahu wa waladahu, wa barik lahu feema a'taytah.
translation: O Allah, increase his wealth and his children, and bless him in what You have given him.

title: Dua for Someone Who Has Done a Favor or Given Charity
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى آلِ فُلَانٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala ali [Fulan].
translation: O Allah, send blessings upon the family of [so-and-so].

title: Full Greeting of Peace (As-Salam)
arabicText: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: As-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
translation: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

title: Full Response to the Greeting of Peace
arabicText: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: Wa 'alaykumus-salamu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
translation: And upon you be peace, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

title: Dua for Guiding One's Mother or Relatives
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ أُمَّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
transliteration: Allahummah-di umma [Abee Hurayrah / mention relative].
translation: O Allah, guide the mother of [Abu Hurayrah / mention relative].

title: Dua for Guidance of a Community or People
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ قَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Allahummah-di qawmee fa-innahum la ya'lamoon.
translation: O Allah, guide my people, for indeed they do not know.

title: Dua for Blessing in Measures and Provisions of a City
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَكِّلِنَا وَفِي صَاعِنَا وَفِي مُدِّنَا
transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fee makkilina wa fee sa'ina wa fee muddina.
translation: O Allah, bless us in our measures, in our Sa' and in our Mudd.

title: Dua for an Orphan or Young Child (Rubbing Their Head)
arabicText: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ
transliteration: Barakal-lahu feek.
translation: May Allah bless you.

title: Dua for Righteousness and Pious Companionship
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا
transliteration: Allahummar-zuqnee jaleesan saliha.
translation: O Allah, grant me a righteous companion.

title: Dua When Seeing a Muslim Laughing or Smiling
arabicText: أَضْحَكَ اللَّهُ سِنَّكَ
transliteration: Adhakal-lahu sinnak.
translation: May Allah keep you cheerful and smiling.

title: Dua for Protecting One's Tongue and Chastity
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيَّ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيَّ
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika min sharri ma bayna lahyayya, wa min sharri ma bayna rijlayya.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is between my jaws (my tongue) and from the evil of what is between my legs (my private parts).

title: Dua for a Good Ending (Husn al-Khatimah)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا، وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma ahsin 'aqibatana fil-umoori kulliha, wa ajirna min khizyid-dunya wa 'adhabil-akhirah.
translation: O Allah, make our end good in all our affairs, and save us from disgrace in this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

title: Dua for Making the Best of Life its End and the Best Day Meeting Allah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ عُمْرِي آخِرَهُ، وَخَيْرَ عَمَلِي خَوَاتِمَهُ، وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ فِيهِ
transliteration: Allahummaj-'al khayra 'umree akhirahu, wa khayra 'amalee khawatimahu, wa khayra ayyamee yawma alqaka feeh.
translation: O Allah, make the best part of my life its end, the best of my deeds their conclusion, and the best of my days the day on which I meet You.

title: Dua When Wishing for Relief from Severe Trial (Prohibition of Wishing for Death)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي مَا كَانَتِ الْحَيَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا كَانَتِ الْوَفَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي
transliteration: Allahumma ahyinee ma kanatil-hayatu khayran lee, wa tawaffanee idha kanatil-wafatu khayran lee.
translation: O Allah, keep me alive as long as life is better for me, and cause me to die when death is better for me.

title: Dua for Help Against the Agonies of Death
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَسَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ
transliteration: Allahumma a'innee 'ala ghamaratil-mawti wa sakaratil-mawt.
translation: O Allah, help me through the hardships and agonies of death.

title: Asking for Jannat al-Firdaws (The Highest Level of Paradise)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ أَعْلَى الْجَنَّةِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'alukal-Firdawsa a'lal-jannah.
translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You for Al-Firdaws, the highest part of Paradise.

title: Asking for Paradise and Seeking Refuge from Hellfire Three Times
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَأَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'alukal-jannah (3 times), wa astajeeru bika minan-nar (3 times).
translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise (three times), and I seek Your protection from the Fire (three times).

title: Dua for Light in the Grave and Steadfastness at Questioning
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِي بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma thabbitnee bil-qawlith-thabiti fil-hayatid-dunya wa fil-akhirah.
translation: O Allah, keep me firm with the steadfast word in the life of this world and in the Hereafter.

title: Dua for the Deceased Parent to Raise Their Rank in Paradise
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُمَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir li-walidayya warhamhuma warfa' darajatahuma fil-jannah.
translation: O Allah, forgive my parents, have mercy on them, and elevate their rank in Paradise.

title: Dua for Protection from the Squeezing and Darkness of the Grave
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيقِ الدُّنْيَا وَضِيقِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika min deeqid-dunya wa deeqi yawmil-qiyamah.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the constriction of this world and the constriction of the Day of Resurrection.
reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 5085, Sunan Ibn Majah 3870

title: Dua for Dying as a Martyr in the Cause of Allah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْنِي مَنَازِلَ الشُّهَدَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma ballighnee manazilash-shuhada'.
translation: O Allah, cause me to reach the ranks of the martyrs.

title: Dua When Looking in the Mirror
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
transliteration: Alhamdu lillah, Allahumma kama hassanta khalqee fa-hassin khuluqee.
translation: All praise is for Allah. O Allah, just as You have made my external form beautiful, make my character beautiful as well.

title: Dua for Blessing in One's House, Provision, and Forgiveness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، وَوَسِّعْ لِي فِي دَارِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee dhanbee, wa wassi' lee fee daree, wa barik lee fee rizqee.
translation: O Allah, forgive me my sin, make my house spacious for me, and bless me in my provision.

title: Dua When Closing Doors and Covering Vessels at Night
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah.
translation: In the name of Allah (recited when locking doors, extinguishing lamps, and covering food and water vessels at night, as Satan cannot open a locked door or uncover a vessel over which Allah's name was mentioned).

title: Dua for Seeking Blessing in Early Morning Work
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا
transliteration: Allahumma barik li-ummatee fee bukooriha.
translation: O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings.

title: Dua for Ease in Buying, Selling, and Seeking Repayment
arabicText: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى
transliteration: Rahimal-lahu rajulan samhan idha ba'a, wa idhash-tara, wa idhaq-tada.
translation: May Allah have mercy on a person who is easygoing and generous when he sells, when he buys, and when he asks for payment of his rights.

title: Dua for Contentment with What Allah Has Provided
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَاخْلُفْ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ
transliteration: Allahumma qanni'nee bima razaqtanee, wa barik lee feehi, wakhluf 'alayya kulla gha'ibatin lee bi-khayr.
translation: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided for me, bless me in it, and replace for me every absent thing with good.

title: Dua When Losing Something or Misplacing an Item
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَادَّ الضَّالَّةِ، وَهَادِيَ الضَّلَالَةِ، تَهْدِي مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، ارْدُدْ عَلَيَّ ضَالَّتِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma Raddad-dallati, wa Hadiyad-dalalati, tahdee minad-dalalati, urdud 'alayya dallatee bi-qudratika wa sultanika, fa-innaha min 'ata'ika wa fadlik.
translation: O Allah, Returner of the lost and Guide of those who are astray, You guide from misguidance; return to me my lost item by Your power and authority, for indeed it is from Your gift and bounty.

title: Dua When Entering an Uninhabited or Empty Place
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

title: Dua When Seeing Clouds Gathering in the Sky
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika min sharriha.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from its evil.
reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 5099, Sunan Ibn Majah 3889

title: Dua After Rain Falls Upon Seeing the clouds Clear
arabicText: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
transliteration: Mutirna bi-fadlil-lahi wa rahmatih.
translation: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.

title: Remembrance and Takbir During a Solar or Lunar Eclipse
arabicText: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنَا
transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Astaghfirullah, Allahummar-hamna.
translation: Allah is the Greatest; I seek forgiveness from Allah; O Allah, have mercy upon us (The Prophet commanded calling upon Allah, making Takbir, praying, and giving charity during eclipses).

title: Dua Upon Hearing the Rooster Crow in the Morning
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik.
translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You of Your bounty.

title: Dua Upon Seeing the Early Fruits of the Harvest
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَرَيْتَنَا أَوَّلَهُ فَأَرِنَا آخِرَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma kama araytana awwalahu fa-arina akhirah.
translation: O Allah, just as You have shown us its beginning, show us its end [in safety and blessing].

title: Dua After Drinking Water or Any Beverage
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانَا عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ، وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُوبِنَا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee saqana 'adhban furatan bi-rahmatihi, wa lam yaj'alhu milhan ujajan bi-dhunoobina.
translation: All praise is for Allah, Who gave us sweet, fresh water to drink by His mercy, and did not make it salty and bitter due to our sins.

title: Dua When Drinking Zamzam Water
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا، وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan wasi'an, wa shifa'an min kulli da'.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and a cure from every illness.
reference: Mustadrak al-Hakim 1739, Sunan ad-Daraqutni (Dua of Ibn Abbas)

title: Dua After Eating and Drinking (Short Form)
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَ وَسَقَى وَسَوَّغَهُ وَجَعَلَ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee at'ama wa saqa wa sawwaghahu wa ja'ala lahu makhraja.
translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed and gave drink, made it easy to swallow, and made for it an exit.

title: Dua After Eating a Meal
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعَمْتَ وَأَسْقَيْتَ وَأَغْنَيْتَ وَأَقْنَيْتَ وَهَدَيْتَ وَأَحْيَيْتَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَعْطَيْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma at'amta wa asqayta wa aghnayta wa aqnayta wa hadayta wa ahyayta, falakal-hamdu 'ala ma a'tayt.
translation: O Allah, You have fed, given drink, enriched, sufficed, guided, and given life; so to You belongs all praise for what You have given.

title: Dua for Blessing in Food When Eating Together
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا
transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, Allahumma barik lana feema razaqtana.
translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Allah, bless us in what You have provided for us.
reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 3764 (Gather over your food and mention Allah's name)

title: Dua When Embarking on a Ship or Boat
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha, inna Rabbee la-Ghafoorur-Raheem.
translation: In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.

title: Dua When Ascending a High Place on a Journey
arabicText: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar.
translation: Allah is the Greatest.

title: Dua When Descending into a Valley on a Journey
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Subhanallah.
translation: Glory be to Allah (How perfect Allah is).

title: Dua When Approaching One's Home City After Travel
arabicText: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
transliteration: Ayiboona ta'iboona 'abidoona li-Rabbina hamidoon.
translation: We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

title: Dua for Safety and Protection During Night Travel
arabicText: يَا أَرْضُ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكِ اللَّهُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّكِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيكِ، وَشَرِّ مَا خُلِقَ فِيكِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَدِبُّ عَلَيْكِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَسَدٍ وَأَسْوَدَ، وَمِنَ الْحَيَّةِ وَالْعَقْرَبِ، وَمِنْ سَاكِنِ الْبَلَدِ، وَمِنْ وَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
transliteration: Ya ardu Rabbee wa Rabbukil-lahu, a'oodhu billahi min sharriki wa sharri ma feeki, wa sharri ma khuliqa feeki, wa min sharri ma yadibbu 'alayki, wa a'oodhu billahi min asadin wa aswada, wa minal-hayyati wal-'aqrabi, wa min sakinil-baladi, wa min walidin wa ma walad.
translation: O earth, my Lord and your Lord is Allah. I seek refuge in Allah from your evil, the evil of what is in you, the evil of what has been created in you, and the evil of what crawls upon you. And I seek refuge in Allah from lions, large black snakes, scorpions, from the inhabitants of the land (jinn), and from the begetter (Iblis) and what he begot.

title: Morning and Evening Remembrance for Protection from Harm
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ فاطرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, la ilaha illa Anta, Rabba kulli shay'in wa Maleekahu, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih.
translation: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, there is no deity except You, Lord and Sovereign of all things; I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Satan and his traps.

title: Morning Remembrance After Fajr Prayer for Protection
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahumma ajirnee minan-nar (Seven times).
translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire (Recited seven times after Fajr and Maghrib prayers).

title: Morning Remembrance of Gratitude and Praise
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ، فَأَتِمَّ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee asbahtu minka fee ni'matin wa 'afiyatin wa sitrin, fa-atimma ni'mataka 'alayya wa 'afiyataka wa sitraka fid-dunya wal-akhirah.
translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning enjoying blessings, well-being, and concealment of faults from You; so complete Your blessings, Your well-being, and Your concealment upon me in this world and the Hereafter.

title: Waking Up at Night for Tahajjud Prayer
arabicText: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (عَشْرًا)، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (عَشْرًا)، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ (عَشْرًا)، سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ (عَشْرًا)، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (عَشْرًا)، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ (عَشْرًا)، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيقِ الدُّنْيَا وَضِيقِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ (عَشْرًا)
transliteration: Allahu Akbar (10x), Alhamdu lillah (10x), Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi (10x), Subhanal-Malikil-Quddoos (10x), Astaghfirullah (10x), La ilaha illallah (10x), Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika min deeqid-dunya wa deeqi yawmil-qiyamah (10x).
translation: Allah is the Greatest (10 times), All praise is for Allah (10 times), Glory and praise be to Allah (10 times), Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy (10 times), I seek forgiveness from Allah (10 times), There is no deity except Allah (10 times), O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the constriction of this world and the constriction of the Day of Resurrection (10 times).

title: Dua After Wudu (Opening the Eight Gates of Paradise)
arabicText: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lahu, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh. Allahummaj-'alnee minat-tawwabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen.
translation: I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who oft-repent and make me among those who purify themselves.

title: Dua During Sajdah (Prostration) for Acceptance and Forgiveness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي، سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ، فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma laka sajadtu, wa bika amantu, wa laka aslamtu, Anta Rabbee, sajada wajhee lilladhee khalaqahu wa sawwarahu, fa-ahsana suwarahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu, tabarakal-lahu Ahsanul-khaliqeen.
translation: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. You are my Lord. My face has prostrated to the One Who created it and formed it, and perfected its form, and brought forth its hearing and its sight. Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.

title: Opening Supplication of Night Prayer (Tahajjud)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ، اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ، إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
transliteration: Allahumma Rabba Jibreela wa Meeka'eela wa Israfeela, Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, Anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. Ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-idhnika, innaka tahdee man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqeem.
translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mika'il, and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen; You judge between Your servants concerning that wherein they differed. Guide me to the truth regarding that wherein they differed, by Your permission; indeed, You guide whom You will to a straight path.

title: Dua for Waiting for Prayer in the Mosque (Angels' Supplication)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ، اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lahu, Allahummar-hamhu, Allahumma tub 'alayh.
translation: O Allah, forgive him; O Allah, have mercy on him; O Allah, accept his repentance (The supplication made by the angels for one who sits in his prayer place waiting for the prayer).

title: Dua at the End of Prayer Taught by the Prophet to Mu'adh ibn Jabal
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma a'innee 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik.
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You in the best manner.

title: Dua for Salat al-Hajah (Prayer of Need)
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ، وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ، لَا تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-Haleemul-Kareem, Subhanallahi Rabbil-'Arshil-'Adheem, Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen. As'aluka موجبات (moojibati) rahmatika, wa 'aza'ima maghfiratika, wal-ghaneemata min kulli birrin, was-salamata min kulli ithmin. La tada' lee dhanban illa ghafartahu, wa la hamman illa farrajtahu, wa la hajatan hiya laka ridan illa qadaytaha ya Arhamar-rahimeen.
translation: There is no deity except Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. I ask You for that which necessitates Your mercy, and that which resolves Your forgiveness, and a share of every righteousness, and safety from every sin. Do not leave for me any sin except that You forgive it, nor any worry except that You relieve it, nor any need that is pleasing to You except that You fulfill it, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

title: Dua Calling Upon Allah by His Greatest Name (Ismullah al-A'dham)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamda la ilaha illa Antal-Mannanu Badee'us-samawati wal-ardi, ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikrami, ya Hayyu ya Qayyoom.
translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You by virtue of the fact that all praise belongs to You; there is no deity except You, the Bestower of favors, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all existence.

title: Persisting in Calling Upon Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram
arabicText: يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram.
translation: O Possessor of Majesty and Honor (The Prophet said: 'Be constant in saying Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram').

title: Praise of Allah That Fills the Scales and the Heavens and Earth
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلَأُ الْمِيزَانَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلَآَنِ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi tamla'ul-meezana, wa Subhanallahi wal-hamdu lillahi tamla'ani ma baynas-samawati wal-ard.
translation: 'Alhamdulillah' (All praise is for Allah) fills the scale, and 'Subhanallah wal-hamdulillah' (Glory be to Allah and all praise is for Allah) fill what is between the heavens and the earth.

title: Multiplying Praise and Remembrance of Allah
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
transliteration: Subhanallahi 'adada ma khalaqa, Subhanallahi mil'a ma khalaqa, Subhanallahi 'adada ma fil-ardi was-sama'i, Subhanallahi mil'a ma fil-ardi was-sama'i, Subhanallahi 'adada ma ahsa kitabuhu, Subhanallahi mil'a ma ahsa kitabuhu, Subhanallahi 'adada kulli shay'in, wa Subhanallahi mil'a kulli shay'.
translation: Glory be to Allah to the number of what He created; Glory be to Allah filling what He created; Glory be to Allah to the number of what is in the earth and the heaven; Glory be to Allah filling what is in the earth and the heaven; Glory be to Allah to the number of what His Book has enumerated; Glory be to Allah filling what His Book has enumerated; Glory be to Allah to the number of everything; and Glory be to Allah filling everything.

title: Takbirat of Eid and the First Ten Days of Dhul-Hijjah
arabicText: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaha illallahu, wallahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahil-hamd.
translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is no deity except Allah; and Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and to Allah belongs all praise.
reference: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 5651, Irwa' al-Ghalil 654

title: Praise of Allah Who Has Neither Taken a Son Nor Partner
arabicText: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا
transliteration: Wa qulil-hamdu lillahil-ladhee lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu shareekun fil-mulki wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun minadh-dhulli wa kabbirhu takbeera.
translation: And say, 'All praise is due to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification.'

title: Exalting the Lord of Might Above What They Describe
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ۝ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: Subhana Rabbika Rabbil-'izzati 'amma yasifoon, wa salamun 'alal-mursaleen, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen.
translation: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace upon the messengers. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

title: Declaration of Tawheed and Allah's Supreme Attributes (Surah Al-Hashr)
arabicText: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ ۖ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ ۝ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ۝ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
transliteration: Huwal-lahul-ladhee la ilaha illa Huwa 'Alimul-ghaybi wash-shahadati Huwar-Rahmanur-Raheem. Huwal-lahul-ladhee la ilaha illa Huwal-Malikul-Quddoosus-Salamul-Mu'minul-Muhayminul-'Azeezul-Jabbarul-Mutakabbir, Subhanallahi 'amma yushrikoon. Huwal-lahul-Khaliqul-Bari'ul-Musawwiru lahul-Asma'ul-Husna, yusabbihu lahu ma fis-samawati wal-ardi wa Huwal-'Azeezul-Hakeem.
translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

title: Dua for Beneficial Knowledge and Refuge from Useless Knowledge
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Allahumman-fa'nee bima 'allamtanee, wa 'allimnee ma yanfa'unee, wa zidnee 'ilma.
translation: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me that which will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

title: Dua for Guidance and Steadfastness (As-Sadad)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
transliteration: Allahummah-dinee wa saddidnee.
translation: O Allah, guide me and keep me on the right and straight course.

title: Dua for Inspiring Guidance and Protection from One's Own Soul
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
transliteration: Allahumma alhimnee rushdee, wa a'idhnee min sharri nafsee.
translation: O Allah, inspire me with guidance and protect me from the evil of my own soul.

title: Dua for Seeing Truth as Truth and Falsehood as Falsehood
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَرِنَا الْحَقَّ حَقًّا وَارْزُقْنَا اتِّبَاعَهُ، وَأَرِنَا الْبَاطِلَ بَاطِلًا وَارْزُقْنَا اجْتِنَابَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma arinal-haqqa haqqan warzuqnat-tiba'ahu, wa arinal-batila batilan warzuqnaj-tinabah.
translation: O Allah, show us the truth as truth and grant us the ability to follow it, and show us falsehood as falsehood and grant us the ability to avoid it.
reference: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (Reported from Umar ibn al-Khattab)

title: Dua for Purification of the Soul and Taqwa
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا، وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا، أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا
transliteration: Allahumma ati nafsee taqwaha, wa zakkiha Anta khayru man zakkaha, Anta Waliyyuha wa Mawlaha.
translation: O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it, for You are the best to purify it. You are its Guardian and its Master.

title: Dua for Firmness in the Matter and Determination in Guidance
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ، وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ شُكْرَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَحُسْنَ عِبَادَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قَلْبًا سَلِيمًا، وَلِسَانًا صَادِقًا، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا تَعْلَمُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'alukath-thabata fil-amri, wal-'azeemata 'alar-rushdi, wa as'aluka moojibati rahmatika, wa 'aza'ima maghfiratika, wa as'aluka shukra ni'matika, wa husna 'ibadatika, wa as'aluka qalban saleeman, wa lisanan sadiqan, wa as'aluka min khayri ma ta'lamu, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri ma ta'lamu, wa astaghfiruka lima ta'lamu, innaka Anta 'Allamul-ghuyoob.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in all affairs and determination upon right guidance. I ask You for that which necessitates Your mercy and resolves Your forgiveness. I ask You for gratitude for Your blessings and excellence in worshipping You. I ask You for a sound heart and a truthful tongue. I ask You for the good of what You know, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You know, and I seek Your forgiveness for what You know; indeed, You are the Knower of the unseen.

title: Dua for Endearing Faith to the Heart and Making Disbelief Hateful
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma habbib ilaynal-eemana wa zayyinhu fee quloobina, wa karrih ilaynal-kufra wal-fusooqa wal-'isyana, waj'alna minar-rashideen.
translation: O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts, and make hateful to us disbelief, defiance, and disobedience, and make us among the rightly guided.

title: Dua for Dying as Muslims and Joining the Righteous Without Disgrace
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ، وَأَحْيِنَا مُسْلِمِينَ، وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِينَ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ
transliteration: Allahumma tawaffana muslimeena, wa ahyina muslimeena, wa alhiqna bis-saliheena ghayra khazaya wa la maftooneen.
translation: O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims, keep us alive as Muslims, and join us with the righteous, neither disgraced nor subjected to trial.

title: Praise for Allah Who Guided Us to This
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِهَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلَا أَنْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee hadana li-hadha wa ma kunna li-nahtadiya lawla an hadanal-lah.
translation: All praise is due to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us.

title: Dua for Understanding, Wisdom, and Remembrance of What is Learned
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ عَلَيَّ فُتُوحَ الْعَارِفِينَ بِحِكْمَتِكَ، وَانْشُرْ عَلَيَّ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَذَكِّرْنِي مَا نَسِيتُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Allahummaf-tah 'alayya futoohal-'arifeena bi-hikmatika, wanshur 'alayya rahmataka, wa dhakkirnee ma naseetu ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram.
translation: O Allah, open for me the openings of those endowed with knowledge through Your wisdom, spread upon me Your mercy, and remind me of what I have forgotten, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

title: Exalting Allah as We Have No Knowledge Except What He Taught Us (Angels' Dua)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
transliteration: Subhanaka la 'ilma lana illa ma 'allamtana innaka Antal-'Aleemul-Hakeem.
translation: Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise.

title: Dua for Seeking Light in the Heart and Sight
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا، وَفَوْقِي نُورًا، وَتَحْتِي نُورًا، وَأَمَامِي نُورًا، وَخَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا
transliteration: Allahummaj-'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an yasaree nooran, wa fawqee nooran, wa tahtee nooran, wa amamee nooran, wa khalfee nooran, waj'al lee noora.
translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, light on my right, light on my left, light above me, light below me, light in front of me, light behind me, and grant me light.

title: Intention and Entering Ihram for Umrah
arabicText: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ عُمْرَةً
transliteration: Labbaykal-lahumma 'Umratan.
translation: Here I am, O Allah, performing Umrah.

title: Intention and Entering Ihram for Hajj
arabicText: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ حَجًّا
transliteration: Labbaykal-lahumma Hajjan.
translation: Here I am, O Allah, performing Hajj.

title: Stipulation Clause (Ishtirat) When Fearing an Obstacle in Hajj or Umrah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ حَبَسْتَنِي
transliteration: Allahumma mahillee haythu habastanee.
translation: O Allah, my place of release from Ihram is wherever You detain me.

title: Dua Upon Seeing the Ka'bah and Entering Masjid al-Haram
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، فَحَيِّنَا رَبَّنَا بِالسَّلَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma Antas-Salamu wa minkas-salamu, fa-hayyina Rabbana bis-salam.
translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace; so greet us, our Lord, with peace.
reference: Sunan al-Kubra (Al-Bayhaqi 5/73, from Umar ibn al-Khattab)

title: Starting Tawaf at the Black Stone (Al-Hajar Al-Aswad)
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Bismillahi wallahu Akbar.
translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
reference: Sunan al-Kubra (Al-Bayhaqi, authentic from Ibn Umar)

title: Recitation When Going Towards Maqam Ibrahim After Tawaf
arabicText: وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى
transliteration: Wattakhidhoo min Maqami Ibraheema musalla.
translation: And take from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer.

title: Dua for an Accepted Hajj and Forgiven Sin
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَبْرُورًا، وَسَعْيًا مَشْكُورًا، وَذَنْبًا مَغْفُورًا
transliteration: Allahummaj-'alhu Hajjan mabrooran, wa sa'yan mashkooran, wa dhanban maghfoora.
translation: O Allah, make it an accepted Hajj, a rewarded effort, and a forgiven sin.
reference: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah (Athari supplication of the Salaf)

title: Dua When Shaving or Trimming Hair (Halq or Taqsir)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lil-muhalliqeena wal-muqassireen.
translation: O Allah, forgive those who shave their heads and those who shorten their hair.

title: Supplication for Those Returning from Hajj or Umrah
arabicText: قَبِلَ اللَّهُ حَجَّكَ، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَأَخْلَفَ نَفَقَتَكَ
transliteration: Qabilal-lahu hajjaka, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa akhlafa nafaqatak.
translation: May Allah accept your Hajj, forgive your sin, and replace your expenditure.

title: Sighting the Crescent of Ramadan and Other Months
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-yumni wal-eemani, was-salamati wal-Islami, Rabbee wa Rabbukal-lah.
translation: O Allah, bring this crescent upon us with blessing and faith, and with safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

title: Tasbih After the Witr Prayer in Ramadan and Throughout the Year
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ، سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ، سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ، رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliteration: Subhanal-Malikil-Quddoos (3 times), Rabbil-mala'ikati war-Rooh.
translation: Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy (three times), Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

title: Dua for Acceptance of Fasting and Night Prayers
arabicText: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka Antas-Samee'ul-'Aleem, wa tub 'alayna innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Raheem.
translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us; indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing. And accept our repentance; indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

title: Greeting of Congratulations on Eid Day
arabicText: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ
transliteration: Taqabbalal-lahu minna wa minkum.
translation: May Allah accept [good deeds] from us and from you.
reference: Fath al-Bari (2/446, graded Hasan by Ibn Hajar from the Companions)

title: Dua for Blessing in Suhoor (The Pre-Dawn Meal)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي سُحُورِنَا وَأَعِنَّا عَلَى صِيَامِنَا وَقِيَامِنَا
transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fee suhoorina wa a'inna 'ala siyamana wa qiyamina.
translation: O Allah, bless us in our pre-dawn meal (Suhoor) and help us in our fasting and our night prayers.
reference: Derived from Sahih al-Bukhari 1923 ('Partake in Suhoor, for indeed in Suhoor there is blessing')

title: Seeking Forgiveness at Dawn (Time of Suhoor)
arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfirul-lahal-'Adheema wa atoobu ilayh.
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent and repent to Him (Praised in Quran 3:17 & 51:18: 'And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness').

title: Dua When Breaking Fast With Dates or Water
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Bismillahi, dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in sha'al-lah.
translation: In the name of Allah; the thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is assured, if Allah wills.

title: Dua for Freedom from Hellfire in Ramadan
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْتِقْ رِقَابَنَا وَرِقَابَ آبَائِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahumma a'tiq riqabana wa riqaba aba'ina wa ummahatina minan-nar.
translation: O Allah, free our necks and the necks of our fathers and mothers from the Hellfire.
reference: Derived from Sunan Ibn Majah 1643 ('Allah has people whom He frees from the Fire every night of Ramadan')

title: Salat al-Ibrahimiyyah (Most Complete Salawat Upon the Prophet)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala ali Ibraheema, innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala ali Ibraheema, innaka Hameedun Majeed.
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

title: Salawat Upon the Prophet, His Wives, and His Offspring
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibraheema, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kama barakta 'ala ali Ibraheema, innaka Hameedun Majeed.
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and his wives and his offspring, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad and his wives and his offspring, just as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

title: Salawat Upon Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadinin-Nabiyyil-Ummiyyi wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala ali Ibraheema, wa barik 'ala Muhammadinin-Nabiyyil-Ummiyyi wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala ali Ibraheema, innaka Hameedun Majeed.
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and the family of Muhammad, just as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

title: Salawat Upon Muhammad, Allah's Servant and Messenger
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasoolika, kama sallayta 'ala Ibraheema, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Ibraheema wa ali Ibraheem.
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger, just as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, just as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim.

title: Concise Salawat and Salam Upon the Prophet
arabicText: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
transliteration: Sallallahu 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi wa sallam.
translation: May Allah send prayers and peace upon him and upon his family.

title: Asking for the Prophet's Intercession and the Praised Station
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْزِلْهُ الْمَقْعَدَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa anzilhul-maq'adal-muqarraba 'indaka yawmal-qiyamah.
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and grant him the station of nearness to You on the Day of Resurrection (Whoever says this, the Prophet's intercession becomes assured for him).

title: Greeting the Prophet When Passing By His Grave
arabicText: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: As-salamu 'alayka ya Rasoolallahi wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
translation: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

title: Quranic Command to Send Blessings and Peace Upon the Prophet
arabicText: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
transliteration: Innal-laha wa mala'ikatahu yusalloona 'alan-Nabiyy, ya ayyuhal-ladheena amanoo salloo 'alayhi wa sallimoo tasleema.
translation: Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.

title: Rabbi: Making Me and My Offspring Grateful and Righteous
arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee.
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring.

title: Rabbi: Do Not Place Me Among the Wrongdoing People
arabicText: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi fala taj'alnee fil-qawmidh-dhalimeen.
translation: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.

title: Rabbi: Never Being an Assistant to the Criminals (Musa's Pledge)
arabicText: رَبِّ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi bima an'amta 'alayya falan akoona dhaheeran lil-mujrimeen.
translation: My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals.

title: Rabbi: Granting Wisdom, Joining the Righteous, and Forgiving Father (Ibrahim's Full Dua)
arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ ۝ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ ۝ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis-saliheen, waj'al lee lisana sidqin fil-akhireen, waj'alnee min warathati jannatin-na'eem.
translation: My Lord, grant me authority [and wisdom] and join me with the righteous. And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

title: Rabbi: Saving Me and My Family from What They Do (Lut's Dua)
arabicText: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Rabbi najjinee wa ahlee mimma ya'maloon.
translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do.

title: Rabbi: My People Have Denied Me, So Decide Between Us (Nuh's Dua)
arabicText: رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ ۝ فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi inna qawmee kadhdhaboon, faftah baynee wa baynahum fathan wa najjinee wa man ma'iya minal-mu'mineen.
translation: My Lord, indeed my people have denied me. Then judge between me and them with decisive judgment and save me and those with me of the believers.

title: Rabbi: Forgiving My Sin on the Day of Judgment
arabicText: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ
transliteration: Walladhee atma'u an yaghfira lee khatee'atee yawmad-deen.
translation: And Who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense.

title: Rabbana: Seeking Mercy and Guidance in Our Affair
arabicText: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ سَيُؤْتِينَا اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَرَسُولُهُ إِنَّا إِلَى اللَّهِ رَاغِبُونَ
transliteration: Hasbunal-lahu sayu'teenal-lahu min fadlihi wa rasooluhu inna ilal-lahi raghiboon.
translation: Sufficient for us is Allah; Allah will give us of His bounty, and [so will] His Messenger; indeed, we are desirous toward Allah.

title: Reliance Upon the Ever-Living Who Never Dies
arabicText: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا
transliteration: Wa tawakkal 'alal-Hayyil-ladhee la yamootu wa sabbih bi-hamdih, wa kafa bihi bi-dhunoobi 'ibadihi Khabeera.
translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted.

title: Allah Is Sufficient for Whoever Relies Upon Him
arabicText: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
transliteration: Wa man yatawakkal 'alal-lahi fahuwa hasbuh, innal-laha balighu amrih, qad ja'alal-lahu li-kulli shay'in qadra.
translation: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

title: Taqwa Brings a Way Out and Provision from Unexpected Sources
arabicText: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
transliteration: Wa man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhrajan, wa yarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasib.
translation: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and will provide for him from where he does not expect.

title: Glory Be to Our Lord; Indeed the Promise of Our Lord Is Fulfilled
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
transliteration: Subhana Rabbina in kana wa'du Rabbina la-maf'oola.
translation: Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled.

title: Praise of Allah Who Removed All Sorrow From Us (People of Paradise)
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee adhhaba 'annal-hazana inna Rabbana la-Ghafoorun Shakoor.
translation: Praise to Allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative.

title: Praise of Allah Who Fulfilled His Promise to Us
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee sadaqana wa'dahu wa awrathanal-arda natabawwa'u minal-jannati haythu nasha'u fani'ma ajrul-'amileen.
translation: Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers.

title: Praise of Allah Who Favored Us Over Many of His Believing Servants (Dawud and Sulayman)
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee faddalana 'ala katheerin min 'ibadihil-mu'mineen.
translation: Praise to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.

title: Praise of Allah Who Saved Us from the Wrongdoing People (Nuh's Praise)
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee najjana minal-qawmidh-dhalimeen.
translation: Praise to Allah, who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.

title: Peace and Praise in Paradise (Closing Prayer of the Believers)
arabicText: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ ۚ وَآخِرُ دَعْوَاهُمْ أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: Da'wahum feeha Subhanakal-lahumma wa tahiyyatuhum feeha salam, wa akhiru da'wahum anil-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen.
translation: Their call therein will be, 'Exalted are You, O Allah,' and their greeting therein will be, 'Peace.' And the last of their call will be, 'Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds!'

title: No Power Except With Allah (When Entering One's Garden or Property)
arabicText: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Ma sha'al-lahu la quwwata illa billah.
translation: What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah.

title: Dua for Relief from Distress and Hardship (Quranic Promise)
arabicText: سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
transliteration: Sayaj'alul-lahu ba'da 'usrin yusra.
translation: Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.

title: Seeking Help Through Patience and Prayer
arabicText: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
transliteration: Wasta'eenoo bis-sabri was-salati, wa innaha la-kabeeratun illa 'alal-khashi'een.
translation: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah].

title: Dua of the Prophet on the Day of Ta'if (In Extreme Weakness and Distress)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُو ضَعْفَ قُوَّتِي، وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي، وَهَوَانِي عَلَى النَّاسِ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، أَنْتَ رَبُّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ، وَأَنْتَ رَبِّي، إِلَى مَنْ تَكِلُنِي؟ إِلَى بَعِيدٍ يَتَجَهَّمُنِي؟ أَمْ إِلَى عَدُوٍّ مَلَّكْتَهُ أَمْرِي؟ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِكَ عَلَيَّ غَضَبٌ فَلَا أُبَالِي، وَلَكِنَّ عَافِيَتَكَ هِيَ أَوْسَعُ لِي، أَعُوذُ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ الظُّلُمَاتُ، وَصَلُحَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، مِنْ أَنْ تُنْزِلَ بِي غَضَبَكَ، أَوْ يَحِلَّ عَلَيَّ سَخَطُكَ، لَكَ الْعُتْبَى حَتَّى تَرْضَى، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma ilayka ashkoo da'fa quwwatee, wa qillata heelatee, wa hawanee 'alan-nasi, ya Arhamar-rahimeen. Anta Rabbul-mustad'afeena, wa Anta Rabbee, ila man takilunee? Ila ba'eedin yatajahhamunee? Am ila 'aduwwin mallaktahu amree? In lam yakun bika 'alayya ghadabun fala ubalee, wa lakinna 'afiyataka hiya awsa'u lee. A'oodhu bi-noori Wajhikal-ladhee ashraqat lahudh-dhulumatu, wa saluha 'alayhi amrud-dunya wal-akhirati, min an tunzila bee ghadabaka, aw yahilla 'alayya sakhatuk. Lakal-'utba hatta tarda, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bik.
translation: O Allah, to You I complain of my weakness, my lack of resources, and my insignificance before people, O Most Merciful of the merciful! You are the Lord of the oppressed, and You are my Lord. To whom do You entrust me? To a distant person who receives me with hostility? Or to an enemy to whom You have granted authority over my affair? So long as You are not angry with me, I do not care; yet Your well-being is more expansive for me. I seek refuge in the light of Your Face, by which all darkness is illuminated and upon which the affairs of this world and the Hereafter are set right, lest Your wrath descend upon me or Your displeasure befall me. To You belongs the right to be pleased until You are pleased, and there is no power and no might except through You.

title: Dua for Relief from Worry and Debt Taught to Abu Umamah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wa a'oodhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali, wa a'oodhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa a'oodhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.

title: Dua for Loving Righteousness and Caring for the Poor
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ، وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ، وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي، وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ فِتْنَةَ قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ
transliteration: Allahumma innee as'aluka fi'lal-khayrati, wa tarkal-munkarati, wa hubbal-masakeeni, wa an taghfira lee wa tarhamanee, wa idha aradta fitnata qawmin fa-tawaffanee ghayra maftoon.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the doing of good deeds, the abandonment of evil deeds, and the love of the poor; and that You forgive me and have mercy upon me; and when You intend a trial for a people, cause me to die without being afflicted by that trial.

title: Dua for Sufficiency and Protection When Facing Any Difficulty
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا عَيْشَ إِلَّا عَيْشُ الْآخِرَهْ
transliteration: Allahumma la 'aysha illa 'ayshul-akhirah.
translation: O Allah, there is no true life except the life of the Hereafter.

title: Prophetic Dua During the Battle of the Trench (Ahzab)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِنَا وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِنَا
transliteration: Allahummas-tur 'awratina wa amin raw'atina.
translation: O Allah, conceal our vulnerabilities and calm our fears.

title: Dua for Blessing in Provision and Contentment of Heart
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ عِنْدَ كِبَرِ سِنِّي وَانْقِطَاعِ عُمْرِي
transliteration: Allahummaj-'al awsa'a rizqika 'alayya 'inda kibari sinnee wan-qita'i 'umree.
translation: O Allah, grant me the most abundant of Your provision in my old age and toward the end of my life.

title: Dua for Protection from All Evil Desires and Diseases
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَدْوَاءِ
transliteration: Allahumma jannibnee munkaratil-akhlaqi wal-ahwa'i wal-a'mali wal-adwa'.
translation: O Allah, keep me away from evil character traits, evil desires, evil deeds, and evil diseases.

title: Dua for Acceptance of Repentance and Cleansing of the Heart
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِكُلِّ ذَنْبٍ يَعْقِبُ الْحَسْرَةَ، وَيُورِثُ النَّدَامَةَ، وَيَحْبِسُ الرِّزْقَ، وَيَرُدُّ الدُّعَاءَ
transliteration: Allahumma innee astaghfiruka li-kulli dhanbin ya'qibul-hasrata, wa yoorithun-nadamata, wa yahbisur-rizqa, wa yaruddud-du'a'.
translation: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness for every sin that brings about regret, leaves behind remorse, withholds provision, and holds back supplication.

title: Dua for Gratitude and Remembrance at All Times
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أُعَظِّمُ شُكْرَكَ، وَأُكْثِرُ ذِكْرَكَ، وَأَتَّبِعُ نَصِيحَتَكَ، وَأَحْفَظُ وَصِيَّتَكَ
transliteration: Allahummaj-'alnee u'adhdhimu shukraka, wa ukthiru dhikraka, wa attabi'u naseehataka, wa ahmadhu wasiyyatak.
translation: O Allah, make me one who magnifies Your gratitude, multiplies Your remembrance, follows Your counsel, and preserves Your command.
